title: Relax bulk Te-I unit cell
action: Using DFT with PBE functional and DFT-D2 van der Waals correction, fully relax the bulk trigonal Te (Te-I) unit cell (space group P3121) to obtain the reference total energy per atom E_bulk_per_atom.
description: Compute total energy of the relaxed bulk Te unit cell and divide by the number of atoms to get the per‑atom reference energy.

title: Construct and relax Te slabs for N = 1 to 20 layers
action: For each integer N from 1 to 20, construct a slab by truncating the relaxed bulk structure along [001] with N atomic layers, add ~20 Å vacuum, and fully relax atomic positions and cell degrees of freedom using the same DFT settings (PBE+DFT-D2). Record the total energy of each slab.
description: Generate slab total energies needed to compute formation energies. The agent must handle the relaxation for all N values.

title: Compute formation energies and write formation_energies.csv
action: For each N, compute Ef(N) = [E_slab(N) − N · E_bulk_per_atom] / N and write a CSV file with columns N, E_slab_total (eV), E_bulk_per_atom (eV), and Ef (eV/atom).
description: CSV with N=1..20 and the corresponding formation energies. The checker derives magic thicknesses from local minima in Ef.
output_schema: N (int), E_slab_total (float, eV), E_bulk_per_atom (float, eV), Ef (float, eV/atom). One row per N.

title: Compute interlayer coupling energy between α-Te trilayers
action: From the relaxed 3‑layer and 6‑layer slabs, compute the interlayer binding energy per unit area: (E_6layer − 2×E_3layer) / (in‑plane area per unit cell). Output in meV/Å² to a text file.
description: Measures van der Waals attraction between tellurene monolayers. Calculated from the relevant relaxed slab energies.
output_schema: Single line containing a floating-point number and the unit ' meV/Å^2'.
